Initiative:
Scientific Issues
Project name: Scientific review on "Low-tar Products"
Objective: Develop as a team effort a scientific review on "Low-tar Products" by September 1999
Project Leader: Roger Walk
Tactics and Milestones:
1. Prepare draft of a review using the presentation by Dr. Carchman earlier this year by July 1999.
2. Obtain review of epidemiology from Dr. P. Lee by June 1999.
3. Obtain product-related information from other PM sources by July 1999.
4. Obtain biology-related information from INBIFO by July 1999.
5. Prepare reference list and collect all referenced articles as copies by July 1999.
6. As we go forward, present draft review and intermediate drafts at WSA internal meetings for discussion among peers.
7. Organize comprehensive presentation and discussion meeting on draft review in mid September 1999.
8. Decide about submission of publication by end September 1999.
